messages:
elena: Customer BrightWave reported an AMEX corporate card declined when trying to pay invoice INV-2932 via our billing portal. They pasted the bank message: 'DECLINE - MCC RESTRICTED'. They say card works elsewhere. Can someone take?

sam-support: Got it — can you paste the gateway txn id and the decline code from our logs? Also ask if they have any corporate MCC allowlist.

elena: From logs: ```gateway_txn: pay_1JkL4a9YcH decline_code: do_not_honor mcc: 7392 card_brand: American Express card_last4: 3456``` Customer says their card admin enforces MCC blocks for "Professional Services" (they called it a corporate policy).

payments-bot: Payment gateway (stripe) webhook: charge.failed -> code=do_not_honor, outcome: issuer_decline, network_reason: "mcc_restricted".

nina-billing: 7392 maps to "Business Services / Professional" in our MCC map. If the issuer blocks that MCC the charge will be rejected before auth. Do we know if BrightWave's admin has an MCC allowlist?

elena: They say their company policy only allows certain vendor categories; they didn't see our vendor on the allowlist.

luca-eng: Quick checklist: 1) confirm invoice amount & currency (they're paying USD 1,250). 2) ensure our merchant descriptor is what the customer expects (we show "REDWOOD INFERENCE" on billing). 3) see if a fallback / alternate payment method is available.

elena: Confirmed amount USD 1250. Customer says descriptor is "REDWOOD INFERENCE" but their AMEX admin shows an unknown merchant so it's blocked. They offered two options: ask their AMEX admin to allow MCC 7392 / our merchant, or try a different corporate card / personal card.

sam-support: Escalation path: if customer wants us to retry we can re-attempt charge once they add us to allowlist. If they want immediate payment we can accept a different card or manual wire/PO. Flagging for finance if they want to complete now.

nina-billing: Also note: for customers with strict PO workflows, we can record a manual payment receipt once they send wire details; that avoids card decline loops.

elena: Customer asked if we can update our MCC or descriptor to avoid future blocks. Any blockers?

luca-eng: MCC is set by the payment processor/merchant account and not something we toggle per-customer. Descriptor can be adjusted but changes can take 48-72 hours with our processor. Not a quick fix.

sam-support: Practical next steps for BrightWave: 1) ask AMEX admin to allow MCC 7392 or merchant descriptor "REDWOOD INFERENCE" (they might need merchant ID from us). 2) try alternate card or manual wire. 3) if they want, we can schedule a 1:1 with Finance to walk through wire details.

elena: I sent the merchant id and instructions to customer and offered wire option. They said they'd ask their AMEX admin first and will update.

[24 hours later]
elena: Update — customer confirmed AMEX admin added our merchant to their allowlist and retried payment. charge.succeeded -> gateway_txn: pay_1JkL4a9YcH-2. Invoice shows paid. Closing the loop. :tada:

sam-support: Great, marking resolved. Leaving note: when decline_code contains "mcc_restricted" advise customers to check corporate MCC allowlist and merchant descriptor, and offer wire/PO as fallback.

nina-billing: Adding a KB snippet to helpdesk: "AMEX/corporate card declines due to MCC blocks — steps for customers".

payments-bot: Log updated: invoice INV-2932 paid via AMEX (masked 3456).
